sections.heading: 1. Three to four times a day
lines: ① Bend the wrist up and down slowly × 10.
② Elbow tucked, turn palm up and down × 10.
③ Spread fingers, then make a fist × 10.
(warm water can make it feel easier!)

caption:
Koko's cast came off after six weeks, and the wrist feels stiff, a bit puffy and weaker than expected.

That's usually normal. The joint and muscles have been still for a while and need gradual loading again. Every fracture is different, so your treating doctor's plan sets what you do and when.

Once cleared, gentle wrist bends, forearm turns and finger movements through the day are a good start. Little and often tends to beat one big session. Later, rehab builds grip, light weights and pushing through the hand.

Increasing pain or swelling, pins and needles, or colour or temperature changes mean contacting your doctor or fracture clinic. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
